state.ok: Cloud copy is up to date
state.off: Cloud copy is not set up

lead.ok: Every bill and change on this computer is also kept safe in the cloud.
lead.starting: The first copy will be made in a few seconds.
lead.problem: Billing still works on this computer. Changes wait here and are sent when the problem is fixed.
lead.off: Your data is only on this computer. If it breaks or is stolen, the data is lost. Set up the cloud copy below.

errors.OFFLINE: Cannot reach the cloud copy. Check the shop internet connection. Tula keeps trying on its own.
errors.AUTH: The cloud refused the access token. Create a new token and put it in TULA_SYNC_TOKEN, then restart Tula.
errors.BAD_URL: The cloud address in TULA_SYNC_URL is not correct. Check it, then restart Tula.
errors.UPDATE_APP: Another computer has a newer version of Tula. Update Tula on this computer to receive its changes.
errors.REVOKED: This computer was marked as lost, so it no longer sends or receives data.

sync.rejected: {{count}} change(s) could not be copied because the same record was entered on two computers. Check daily rates and items on both computers.
sync.notRunning: Sync is configured but not running. Restart Tula.

setup.title: How to set up the cloud copy
setup.step1: Create a free database at turso.tech in the Mumbai region.
setup.step2: Create an access token for that database.
setup.step3: On this computer, put the address and token in Tula's settings file:
setup.step4: Restart Tula. This screen then shows "Cloud copy is up to date".
setup.secret: The token is a password: never send it on WhatsApp or put it in a photo.

phone.title: Open on a phone
phone.step1: Connect the phone to the shop Wi-Fi (the same one as this computer).
phone.step2: Open the camera and scan the code below. Tula opens in the browser.
phone.step3: Sign in with your name and PIN.
phone.step4: In the browser menu, tap "Add to Home screen" so Tula is one tap away next time.
phone.noNetwork: This computer is not connected to a network. Connect it to the shop Wi-Fi or router.
phone.several: This computer has more than one network address. If one code does not open, try the other.
phone.app: Using the Tula Android app instead? Type the address shown under the code once; the app remembers it.

devices.title: Computers and phones sharing this data
devices.help: Each computer, and each phone that works on its own, has its own bill number series. Phones that open Tula from a computer are not listed.
devices.name: Name
devices.confirmLost: Mark "{{name}}" as lost? It will stop sending and receiving data. Also create a new access token so the old one stops working.
devices.lostHelp: If a computer is stolen, mark it as lost and create a new access token in Turso.
